config.grain_rationale: Each row is one employment-services SITE (office/premises) operated by a provider under a specific employment services contract (CONTRACT_NAME, e.g. DESA/DESB/EPS5). The business participant is the provider organisation named in SITE_NAME; the row describes that provider's SITE PREMISES address (street address), plus website and phone contacts. DIS_SITE_CODE is the site identifier, not a business identifier, so it is not mapped to the entity.

record_id.rationale: DIS_SITE_CODE is not unique per record (489 distinct over 505 discovery rows) because the same site appears once per contract code. No other column or combination is guaranteed unique, so a content hash over all mapped source fields is used for traceability.

fields.rationale: SITE_NAME holds the provider's operating/brand name (e.g. 'MAX Employment', 'Advanced Personnel Management', 'CoAct/Community Solutions', 'Job Centre Australia'). These are trading/display names, not evidenced registered legal names, so trading_name (not legal_name). The same provider appears under several variants (e.g. 'Advanced Personnel Management' vs '(APM)').

SITE_URL contains provider domains such as 'www.apm.net.au' or 'http://maxsolutions.com.au/'; present in ~58% of rows. Held-out data showed some non-URL junk in this field (a bare phone number '467027758', 'TTY: 03 96143062'), so a domain-shaped regex gates the value: values without a dotted domain are dropped rather than emitted as a website.

SITE_ADDRESS_LN is the site's PREMISES street address (e.g. '2nd Floor 22 East Row', 'Shop 6 & 7 The HUB Wynyard Street'), which is what address.full represents here; it is not a postal address. Values are truncated at ~40 chars in the source. Held-out data contained the placeholder 'TBA', which is now nulled.
Suburb/town of the site, e.g. 'CANBERRA', 'WOY WOY'; same value domain as LOCATION_NAME (412 distinct each in discovery).
Two/three letter AU state abbreviation (8 distinct discovery values: NSW,VIC,QLD,SA,WA,TAS,NT,ACT).
4-digit AU postcodes; 13 of 505 discovery rows are 3-digit (NT codes such as 822) which the postcode transform re-pads.

constants.rationale: Australian government register of Australian employment-services sites; all states are AU state codes and postcodes are AU format.

unmapped.reason: Short site code (e.g. A230, V352) with no checksum; not unique per record (same site repeats across contract codes). The record's own site ID, not a business identifier.
Employment-services contract type (DESB, DESA, EPS5, TTW5, RJCP...) describing the program under which the site is contracted, not an attribute of the business entity.
Duplicates SITE_LOCALITY_NAME (same 412 distinct value domain) - the site's town; already captured via address.locality.
Site contact phone number; phone is not a target in the canonical ontology.
Contact email only; there is no email target in the ontology and it is not a website (critic concurred). Some values are personal staff addresses (e.g. kal.perera@...), which are not entity fields.
Employment Services Area code (e.g. 5ACT, 4SOE) - a program administrative region, not an ANZSIC industry code and not a business identifier.
Blank in 100% of discovery rows (wrapped second ESA code).
Blank in 100% of discovery rows (wrapped third ESA code).
13/1800 freecall number for the agent; phone is not an ontology target.
Site phone number; phone is not a target in the canonical ontology.
Site geocoordinate; no geo target in the canonical ontology (and 7 discovery rows contain the literal 'NULL').
Site geocoordinate; no geo target in the canonical ontology (and 7 discovery rows contain the literal 'NULL').
Empty trailing column created by trailing delimiter in header; 0% present.

config.notes: No ABN/ACN/NZBN column exists in this extract (checksum-valid rates on numeric columns are ~0%), so no business identifier can be mapped. entity_type is left out because no column states a legal structure. SITE_NAME is trading_name, not legal_name: values are brand names with inconsistent variants. address.full is explicitly the PREMISES (street) address of the site, not a postal address. Held-out fixes: placeholder 'TBA' now nulled in address fields and SITE_NAME; SITE_URL gated by a domain-shaped regex so junk values (bare phone numbers, 'TTY: ...') are dropped instead of erroring.
